caption: The drawing depicts a blue bonnet with a quilted, yellow interior lining. The bonnet has a rounded crown and extends outward to cover the sides of the face, featuring detailed blue and yellow stitching along the front edge. A decorative blue ribbon is attached to the top, and two blue-tinted ribbons hang down from each side, intended to tie under the chin. The bonnet's lower edge has a flared section with a scalloped trim in blue. To the right of the main colored drawing, there are two smaller, less detailed pencil sketches of the same bonnet, one showing a side view and the other a front view, both displaying the structure and design elements of the bonnet without color. The background is a plain, off-white color that transitions to a slight beige tint toward the top edge of the paper.
title: Opera Hood
